_comment: Reviews data. type: 'text' | 'image'. For image type, provide image path OR leave blank for mock XHS conversation layout.

items.quoteZh: 做得非常仔细，环境也很干净！每次来都很满意，下次还来。
items.quoteEn: The work was very detailed and the studio was very clean! I'm satisfied every time, and I'll definitely be back.

items.quoteZh: Snowy 的手艺真的太棒了！我带了参考图，做出来比图片还好看。
items.quoteEn: Snowy's technique is truly amazing! I brought a reference photo and the result looked even better than the picture.

items.quoteZh: 私人工作室的感觉很好，专注度比店里高很多。光疗做得很持久，两周后还完好无损。
items.quoteEn: The private studio atmosphere is wonderful — so much more focused attention than a salon. The gel lasted perfectly, still intact two weeks later.

items.quoteZh: 太好看了！做得超级细致，工作室也很舒适干净，下次还来！❤️
items.quoteEn: So beautiful! The work is incredibly detailed, and the studio is comfortable and clean. I'll definitely come back! ❤️

items.quoteZh: 中英文都可以沟通，解释了很多护甲的知识，非常专业。价格也很公道。
items.quoteEn: Communication is easy in both English and Chinese. Snowy explained a lot about nail care — very professional. The pricing is also very fair.

items.quoteZh: 第一次来就成功了！预约很方便，到了之后工具都消毒好了，感觉很放心。
items.quoteEn: First visit was a great success! Booking was easy, and when I arrived all tools were already sterilized — felt very safe and reassured.

items.quoteZh: 这个工作室环境非常好，服务态度也很热情。非常满意我的新指甲！
items.quoteEn: The studio environment is excellent, and the service is very friendly. I'm so happy with my new nails!

items.quoteZh: 设计很独特，颜色搭配也很漂亮。Snowy 真的很专业。
items.quoteEn: The design is unique and the color combination is beautiful. Snowy is really professional.

items.quoteZh: 从预约到完成，整个过程都很顺利。指甲做得比想象中还好。
items.quoteEn: From booking to completion, the whole process was smooth. My nails turned out even better than I imagined.

items.quoteZh: Snowy 很细心，颜色和形状都调整得很到位。非常推荐。
items.quoteEn: Snowy was very attentive, and the color and shape were adjusted perfectly. Highly recommend.

items.quoteZh: 每次做完指甲都很满意，持久度也很不错。下次还会再来。
items.quoteEn: I'm satisfied every time I get my nails done, and they last really well. I'll definitely come back.

items.quoteZh: 价格合理，效果非常好。服务也很专业，强烈推荐给想做美甲的朋友。
items.quoteEn: The price is fair and the results are excellent. The service is also professional. I highly recommend it to friends who want nails done.
